What We Do

Services for every
yard & budget

Licensed, insured, and fully equipped for residential and commercial properties across the Salt Lake Valley.

Lawn Maintenance

Weekly or bi-weekly mowing, edging, fertilizing, and aeration. We keep your grass looking sharp all season long without you lifting a finger.

Get a Plan →

Irrigation Systems

Smart sprinkler design, install, and maintenance. Cut your water bill and keep everything green automatically — even when you're away.

Request a Quote →

Landscape Design

Full-property design from concept to completion. Custom plans built around your land, your light, and your lifestyle — then we build it.

Start a Design →

Seasonal Cleanup

Spring clean-up, fall leaf removal, and winter prep. We protect your yard through every season so it's always ready when you need it.

Schedule Cleanup →

Outdoor Lighting

LED pathway, accent, and feature lighting. Make your yard beautiful after dark and actually usable in the evenings year-round.

Explore Lighting →

Hardscaping

Patios, retaining walls, walkways, and fire pits. We do the heavy lifting so you can enjoy the results for years to come.
